name: Investigative
description: Private investigators and journalists who dig for the truth others would rather stayed buried.

bonusFeatChoices.name: Attentive
bonusFeatChoices.description:
Benefit: The character gets a +2 bonus on all Investigate checks and Sense Motive checks. 
Special: Remember that the Investigate skill can’t be used untrained.

bonusFeatChoices.name: Meticulous
bonusFeatChoices.description: Benefit: The character gets a +2 bonus on all Forgery checks and Search checks.
